ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Financial Trail of Minnesota Fraud
ideas.description: Investigation into the financial transactions and networks involved in the Minnesota fraud cases
questions: What are the financial networks and transactions involved in the Minnesota fraud cases?
How do these cases relate to each other and to larger financial trends?
ideas.insight: This story would investigate the financial aspects of the Minnesota fraud cases, and could potentially uncover larger patterns and networks of financial crime
